decisions.reason: Passenger data transmission is close to the firm's aviation security know-how, has its own page and proven adoption by the UK Home Office and over 30 government APIS schemes, so the firm can readily interpret and build on its results.

The travel health API builds on the firm's passenger-processing expertise and has its own page, but post-pandemic demand for health requirements is fading, which raises the risk of it being folded or dropped.
Cyber awareness training fits the firm's certified-trainer and training capabilities, so it can be absorbed, though it is only mentioned on the website and lies somewhat away from physical security.
Behaviour analysis builds directly on the firm's core screening and detection expertise, so its related knowledge supports learning from and improving the system.
Passenger profiling is a core competence in aviation security, which gives the firm strong absorptive capacity to refine the method despite its low website visibility.
Travel and document verification is close to the firm's established document-checking offer and has its own page, so it builds well on existing knowledge.
